facts.fact: 开场 Four 刚从和 Tris 的相处里走开，人在发懵；他说要回公寓，其实只是拿它当借口，好多拖一点两人剩下的时间。
facts.anchor: I’m dazed, walking back to my apartment.

facts.fact: 石坑边半班新生聚着举杯，纪念他们的入门教官 Amar，他死了快两年。
facts.anchor: It’s been almost two years since Amar—our initiation instructor—died.

facts.fact: 官方说他跳下去了，Four 不信这个说法。
facts.anchor: They claimed he jumped, but I’m not convinced.

facts.fact: Amar 死前不久才亲口告诉 Four 自己是 Divergent，说的时候还挺高兴，像不知道这句话的分量。
facts.anchor: He died right after he told me—cheerful, like he didn’t know what it meant—that he was Divergent.

facts.fact: Four 在食堂找 Tori 打听白天那个女孩，Tori 说她给 Tris 做过能力倾向测试。
facts.anchor: Tori raises an eyebrow. “I administered her aptitude test.”

facts.fact: Tori 建议他把那份记录清掉，别让一个无派别的人的名字留在数据里。
facts.anchor: “If I were you, I’d clean up the log anyway,” Tori says.

facts.fact: 不该有人在没有观察员的情况下跑恐惧模拟；有权限这么做的只有 Harrison、Max、Eric 三个领导。
facts.anchor: No one is supposed to run a fear simulation without an observer.

facts.fact: 他让模拟器投出上一个进入者的影像，站在厨房场景里的正是 Erudite 的领袖 Jeanine Matthews。
facts.anchor: She’s Jeanine Matthews. Leader of Erudite.
